full_judgment: 4. We have perused section 20 of Women and Children Oppression (Special Provision) Act, 1995, sub-section (2) of which lays down a period of 90 days for conclusion of the trial with a further provision in sub-section (3) thereof to conclude the trial within an extended period of thirty more days for reasons to be recorded in case of failure of the trial Court to conclude the trial within the first ninety days as fixed in sub-section (2). The Act does not provide for any consequence for failure of the trial Court to conclude the trial within one hundred and twenty days. We have considered this question carefully and hold that the legislature having not provided for any penal provision in case of failure of the trial Court to conclude the trial within a fixed period, this limitation of time for disposal of cases is merely directory and not mandatory in nature.
